title: Release v2.24-multisolver-0.2: equivalence with official CalculiX 2.24

code.note: compared against tag ccx-2.24-upstream (57a4e71) built with upstream's own CMake

summary: SPOOLES, 1 thread: all 642 decks of the official test suite give byte-identical .dat and .frd results to plain 2.24. MUMPS 629/642 and PARDISO 627/642 identical or within tolerance; the rest are explained.
notes: Also covers 4 threads with and without multithreaded SPOOLES, and a macOS smoke test against Dhondt's .dat.ref files.
